records.value: TN5250 retained baseline is oorexx_terminal_machine_v0.21, SHA-256 64fe1cb3b80c2948779a71088dacc2be5edef7b581c99618035fd9b79d8830c5; current 3270 P0 delivery is v0.22-candidate12, SHA-256 e57dcf302070380a6e714ab0a5e8d1adb65b8c27974c34115712dc6314b00f8a.
One live terminal mutation owner; any number of immutable observers. Mutation requires current-generation authority. This applies to TN3270 and TN5250.
Attach observers/controllers around one retained live terminal session; do not create a new host login merely because another AI wants to inspect it.
Transfer control by release/revoke -> no controller -> grant new controller at current generation; never overlap leases.
WLU is external admission/accounting authority. Admission failure must occur before terminal mutation.
Raw passwords stay in trusted local credential/runtime/wire layers and are not passed via argv/environment by host tools.
Snapshots/replay/WatchAlong/known-state persistence expose <SECRET> or masks, never NONDISPLAY field bytes.
Semantic host state and local operator condition are orthogonal; protected-area cursor errors do not create fake host states.
Confirmed PUB400 order: IBM_I_SIGNON -> IBM_I_PASSWORD_EXPIRED_NOTICE -> IBM_I_CHANGE_PASSWORD -> IBM_I_MAIN_MENU.
Signoff only after unique IBM_I_MAIN_MENU match: stage 90, one explicit ENTER, then observe with no further input.
Strict requested DEVNAME collision returns DEVICE_COLLISION; do not silently substitute a new QPADEV device.
Prefer SERVER_ASSIGNED for ordinary PUB400 work unless explicit reconnect/device identity behavior is under test.
Own exact helper PID, verify command identity, TERM with bounded wait, reverify then KILL if required; propagate close failure.
typeAtCursor models terminal-like cursor semantics and may fail/lock in protected space; setField is a separate structured abstraction.
Socket drain -> accepted workers finish -> protocol quiesce; retained terminal/broker stays OPEN. Signoff is separate protected authority.
Service readiness requires lifecycle, listener, acceptor, endpoint and broker state to agree; disagreement is DEGRADED and fails closed.
Journal/time-travel/execution-ticket/retry machinery is EMULATOR/TESTBED/REPLAY_SANDBOX only. LIVE_HOST has no rewind authority; the machinery cannot rewind a remote host.
Live repair requires explicit TerminalEmulatorPatchable; merely method-shaped objects are not patch authority.
Remaining 5250 work includes exact WRITE ERROR CODE pre/post-help semantics, help/post-help signaling and byte-exact Read Immediate x72 regeneration.
Every new live host screen: immutable snapshot -> known-state candidate -> evidence review -> semantic state -> only then automation.

v0.21 TN5250 acceptance under ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196 passed its recorded fresh-package gates; candidate11 later passed the focused r13196 3270 suites. Candidate12 manifest verified in the 2026-10-24 authoring container but was not freshly interpreter-qualified there.

IBM 3270 is the current P0 Terminal Machine line: native Model-2 presentation space, TN3270 first, basic honest TN3270E, structured fields, extended attributes, operator input, semantic snapshots and one-writer ownership.
Current evidence-backed states are HERCULES.TK5.WELCOME_PANEL, MVS.TSO.LOGON_PROMPT, MVS.TSO.PASSWORD_PROMPT, exact-row MVS.TSO.READY, and reference-backed MVS.ISPF.PRIMARY_OPTION_MENU.
Authentication-sensitive READY recognition requires a complete trimmed row exactly equal to READY; READY TO PROCESS, echoed commands and unrelated messages do not count.

TK5 Figure 17 supplies exact documentation evidence for the ISPF primary menu. Require title + Option prompt + END instruction. Do not relabel the manual as live ED209 evidence and do not infer PF/AID authority.

Terminal Machine owns terminal/session/screen/field truth; MVS Alchemy Services owns guest/MVS semantic truth; Hercules Services owns emulator/control-plane truth. Contradictions must be retained rather than collapsed.
Do not migrate TN3270 to Socket Provider until the concrete TCP binding supplies a qualified non-blocking readiness contract; never unwrap raw provider internals simply to obtain select/readiness.

ConnectSelector is an application/service interconnect decision layer. It may expose Terminal Machine through Direct/RPC/Queue paths later, but it is not part of native TN3270/TN5250 datastream semantics.
TerminalControlGate evidence must use its configured protocol source. TN3270 SCREEN_UPDATE and HOST_ROUND_TRIP facts must not carry the historical TN5250 label.
Next high-value gate is same-session differential qualification against s3270 on ED209Z, comparing field geometry/protection/MDT/cursor/visible content rather than only rendered text.

MVS Intention consumes Terminal Machine terminal/session/screen/field evidence but does not inherit terminal mutation authority or MVS/JES job/dataset authority; s3270 remains an independent reference oracle.
On 3270, sending an AID and completing a host semantic transition are distinct. Advance on observed presentation generation/known state, not merely on an emulator scripting action returning.
ED209Z/ED209C and ED209ZZ/ED209I are separate guest/host scopes. Target, host, LU/device, session and evidence source stay attached to observations; never migrate stale facts between Z and ZZ.
MVS batch work is asynchronous: submit identifies work; JES step RCs, diagnostics, spool/printer output and domain artifacts establish outcome. Submission acceptance alone is not success.

MVS Intention dev10 is a qualification-pending downstream candidate: it targets Terminal Machine candidate13 and adopts MVS Alchemy PRE23 completion semantics. FACILITY_PASS alone is INCOMPLETE; HASP395/JES_ENDED and retained final spool are also required before SUCCESS.

Use the complete successful s3270 action response as one reference evidence unit: data lines, 12-field status and final ok. Do not pair ReadBuffer data with separately sampled cursor/dimensions when complete response evidence exists.
s3270 status keyboard U maps to TerminalSnapshot UNLOCKED; L and operator-error E map to LOCKED. Preserve the raw status code for diagnosis and compare keyboard only when status evidence exists.

Current 3270 P0 delivery is oorexx_terminal_machine_v0.22-candidate14.zip SHA-256 2ef05bff6cb9df66041c060d7aceb31e60783948c5a51e9f211b2da7d91111f6; candidate12 remains inherited protocol/model/ownership execution evidence until candidate14 receives fresh r13196 qualification.

Independent r13196 execution exposed a bad s3270 fixture: SF plus eight data cells in an 8-column row is nine positions because SF consumes a display position. Candidate15 requires each ReadBuffer data line to consume exactly columns positions and requires exactly rows lines.
Current 3270 P0 delivery is oorexx_terminal_machine_v0.22-candidate15.zip SHA-256 9153b098543b3d00d334aed5d479b7541e8243138a20d3270700851cd0a1eec7; fresh r13196 rerun remains the next gate.

Candidate16 extends independent s3270 comparison to SFE field attributes 41/42/43/45 and SA character-attribute runs. Character attributes are reduced to a canonical stable digest containing attribute values only, never display data.
Current 3270 P0 delivery is oorexx_terminal_machine_v0.22-candidate16.zip SHA-256 af7c0d571269c17724cc79e695f9b3523045cc7f93a76b595a86158556c60f8d; exact r13196 execution remains the next gate.

MVS Intention dev11 SHA-256 709ff4296094c5ab900f46067ba8287022da794316e9d2652eceae05fc8e906f targets candidate16, retains PRE23 JES completion gating and adds detached s3270 field/extended-attribute evidence retention.
Authenticated 3270 reference tooling must require TSO_PASSWORD at runtime. Never embed a TK5/default password in package source, examples or runtime defaults; retained evidence remains redacted.
